Juno's space ship = is a high tech space ship with a ai PixieThe artificial intelligence of Juno's spaceship. It has some personality, but not enough to replace companionship with another living being. Pixie is treated by Juno as a travelling companion while on her adventures, and tries its best to fulfill the desires of her and the protagonist, even when they're doing something potentially dangerous Pixie is stated to switch between masculine and feminine voices at times, with Juno having told the protagonist during the Time Skip that they don't have a set gender.

Story = The first time Juno tries communicating with the protagonist, she speaks in different unintelligible tones before adjusting her helmet, activating its translation function and allowing her to talk perfectly in the protagonist's language. Protogen biologist from beyond the stars, who claims to be studying the flora and fauna of the protagonist's planet for scientific purposes. In truth, she's looking for symptoms of a dangerous, intergalactic problem, and is on a journey to end it once and for all. She used to have a travelling companion before the Protagonist, a guide from a different planet named Toshi that ended up caught in a trap that almost killed them both. Ever since, Juno has been hesitant to make another friend, though the Protagonist opening up about his past lets her open up as well, admit that Toshi wouldn't want her to be alone forever, and accept the Protagonist
